external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Lennar is proud to partner with Base Power to bring homeowners the latest in energy innovation— integrated battery back-up systems designed to provide security, efficiency, and peace of mind. This exciting collaboration ensures that Lennar homes are equipped with cutting-edge technology that supports sustainable living and reliable power when it’s needed most.

Lennar’s partnership with Dandelion Energy brings homeowners innovative geothermal technology—the most efficient way to heat and cool their homes while reducing long-term costs and helping future-proof where they live. The result is a quiet, comfortable HVAC solution that lasts longer and costs significantly less to operate than traditional systems.

Lennar’s partnership with Fisionˣ by Hotwire Communications brings Gig+ fiber internet directly into your new home, so you’re connected from day one. Pre-installed and included in your HOA, you’ll enjoy ultra-fast, symmetrical speeds and advanced Wi-Fi technology designed for seamless, future-ready connectivity. Plus, explore additional products and services to enhance your connected home experience.

Lennar’s partnership with Opendoor gives you a simpler path from selling your current home to buying your next one, without the hassle of listing it yourself. Explore a cash offer for certainty at closing or, where available, Cash Now, More Later to receive cash upfront with the potential for an additional payment after Opendoor resells your home. With flexible closing options, you can focus on planning your move into your new Lennar home.
